title: Beehive Winter Jacket 194 × 46 cm – Reflective Inside
seo_description: Winter jacket for a beehive, 194 × 46 cm, black fabric with a reflective inside. Attaches with straps and buckles, no drilling.
descriptionHtml:
The hive walls meet winter just as thin as they were in summer

The cold sets in just as the colony has to manage on its own all winter, and the hive walls are built for summer, not for sub-zero temperatures. You find yourself going out to look at the hive a little more often when the wind blows cold.

An outer layer for the hive, with a reflective inside

A jacket in black fabric, 194 × 46 cm, with a silver-colored foil on the inside that shows when the fabric is folded back. It attaches around the hive with straps and buckles — no drilling into the hive.

Features

  • One layer around the whole hive – 194 × 46 cm covers the sides of the hive
  • Reflective inside facing the hive – silver-colored foil shows on the inside
  • Attaches with straps and buckles – you can fasten it yourself, no drilling
  • Black fabric on the outside – the foil sits on the inside, facing the hive

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Our guarantee

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
